Maya R.: Ran ephemeral CA dry-run in eu-west at 09:50 UTC; intermittent TLS handshakes failing through gw-proxy.
Dev S.: timeline? logs?
Maya R.: quick repro: `for i in {1..10}; do curl -v --resolve svc.eu:443:34.90.5.6 https://svc.eu/health || true; done` -> repeated 'no shared cipher' / TLSv1.3 handshake failure.
Theo K.: sounds like cert alg/curve mismatch. What does keystore say?
Maya R.: `keystorectl describe rotator/issuer` shows `algo: ECDSA_P384`, signer in eu-west.
Theo K.: Our gateway cipherlist was restricted to P-256 + RSA. RBAC change to rotator might have flipped the template.
Maya R.: Short fix: add P-384 to canary gw-proxy hosts and restart.
oncall-bot: paging security oncall (p1) — canary patch planned
sec-bot: [audit] RBAC change detected actor=dev.s action=update_issuer key=rotator-v2 at=2025-06-01T09:47:12Z
Maya R.: After patch: canary hosts 10/10 pass; unpatched 2/10 fail.
Theo K.: Next: add rotator CI unit test for allowed_algos, admission webhook check, and audit rule for issuer.algo drift.
Maya R.: Filing follow-ups and tagging for vuln-triage. Closing thread.
